security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting, documentation links, or scoped endpoint configuration rather than shell execution or secret exposure. A private key is used for transaction signing, and documented financial flows can execute or retry on worse terms without an explicit confirmation boundary.

remediation.issue: Private key use for transaction signing
remediation.suggestion: Use a wallet, hardware signer, or narrowly scoped account. Never request, print, or persist private keys in prompts or logs.

remediation.issue: State-changing DeFi actions lack confirmation gates
remediation.suggestion: Show token, amount, recipient or protocol, fees, approval amount, and price impact. Require explicit user approval immediately before submission.
Fetch a fresh quote after failure and require explicit approval before any higher-slippage retry. Set a hard maximum slippage.
Validate endpoint schemes and host allowlists before use. Display selected network and endpoint to the user.

content.value_statement: Starknet DeFi workflows require accurate token, protocol, and transaction details. This skill organizes documented swap, DCA, staking, and lending steps so users can review each action before signing.
actual_capabilities: Build AVNU swap workflows with token, amount, and network inputs.
Describe recurring purchase workflows through Starknet DCA operations.
Guide STRK staking, reward claims, and unstaking actions.
Outline lending and borrowing steps for supported Starknet protocols.
Configure Starknet RPC and AVNU paymaster endpoint variables.
Explain mainnet and Sepolia endpoint selection.
limitations: Does not guarantee quotes, liquidity, fees, execution, or protocol availability.
Does not replace wallet review or independent transaction verification.
Requires a funded Starknet account and correctly configured endpoints.
Supported protocol behavior can change after this skill is published.

use_cases.title: Review a token swap
use_cases.description: Prepare an AVNU swap request and inspect token, amount, quote, approval, and network details before signing.

use_cases.title: Plan recurring purchases
use_cases.description: Define a DCA schedule and review order parameters before creating a recurring purchase.

use_cases.title: Operate a DeFi position
use_cases.description: Follow documented steps for staking, reward claims, lending, borrowing, or repayment.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner swap review
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a simple swap before signing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare a Starknet swap from [TOKEN A] to [TOKEN B] for [AMOUNT]. Show network, quote, fees, approval, price impact, and final confirmation details.

prompt_templates.title: DCA setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a review checklist for a Starknet DCA order to buy [TOKEN] with [TOKEN] every [INTERVAL]. Include budget, schedule, cancellation, and confirmation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Staking workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through staking [AMOUNT] STRK on [NETWORK]. Explain pool selection, lock terms, rewards, fees, and final signing review.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced position review
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess a lending or borrowing action.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Starknet lending or borrowing workflow for [PROTOCOL]. List collateral, debt asset, health factor, liquidation risk, fees, transaction calls, and required confirmations.

output_examples.input: Swap 50 USDC for ETH on Starknet.
output: Action: AVNU swap from USDC to ETH
Review before signing: quote, minimum received, approval amount, price impact, fee, and destination account

output_examples.input: Set up a weekly STRK purchase.
output: Review before creation: payment token, weekly amount, start date, total budget, order identifier, and cancellation process
Review before signing: selected pool, amount, lock rules, reward policy, transaction fee, and account address

best_practices: Verify network, contract, token decimals, amount, and recipient before every signature.
Set conservative price-impact and slippage limits, then obtain a fresh quote before retrying.
Use a dedicated wallet or scoped signer and keep private keys outside prompts and logs.
anti_patterns: Do not approve unlimited token allowances without reviewing the spender and approval amount.
Do not retry a failed swap with higher slippage without a new quote and explicit approval.
Do not treat examples as investment, tax, legal, or protocol-security advice.

faq.question: Which networks does this skill describe?
faq.answer: It documents Starknet mainnet and Sepolia endpoint configuration.

faq.question: Can this skill guarantee a swap price?
faq.answer: No. Quotes, liquidity, fees, and execution can change before a transaction is confirmed.

faq.question: Does gasless mean free?
faq.answer: No. A paymaster can sponsor selected transaction costs, but eligibility and terms can change.

faq.question: Should I provide my private key in a prompt?
faq.answer: No. Keep private keys in a secure signer or wallet. Never paste them into prompts, files, or logs.

faq.question: Can I use this for lending or borrowing?
faq.answer: It can outline documented workflows, but you must review collateral, health factor, liquidation risk, and protocol terms.

faq.question: What should I check before confirming a transaction?
faq.answer: Check network, account, token, amount, approval, minimum received, fees, price impact, and protocol destination.
